_note: The ceremony input of ops/ceremony/mainnet-init.mjs (docs/v9/ceremony-commands.md §2). Copy it to ceremony-input.json (git-ignored: the Helius URL holds a key), replace every <…>, and run the tool; it refuses any placeholder left. Only these six fields: everything else in the Init (key_1, mainnet, mainnet-beta, books, the Ethereum collections, Seaport's and the SignedZone's code hashes read live, the fee caps) is derived by the tool, never typed.
operator: <the runner's IC principal: dfx identity get-principal for the identity whose PEM is the runner's OPERATOR_IDENTITY_PEM>
solana_rpc_urls: https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=<a Helius key for the canister only>
nonce_seed: <1-32 printable ASCII, PERMANENT (the money line's durable-nonce address), e.g. rook-main-1>
